meta.name: One Hundred Years of Solitude
meta.description: In the mythical town Macondo, seven generations of the Buendía family navigate love, oblivion and the inescapability of their past — and their fate.

videos.title: Macondo
videos.overview: Fearing a ghost and a curse, Úrsula and José Arcadio leave their town to establish a new home along a few others, braving a journey through tough terrain.

videos.title: It's Like an Earthquake
videos.overview: Aureliano has visions of a war, while José Arcadio Jr. meets a woman. José Arcadio's alchemy obsession pushes Ursula to find a way to support the family.

videos.title: A Daguerreotype of God
videos.overview: An odd girl brings a delirious sickness to Macondo. José Arcadio becomes fascinated by Melquiades' camera. Rebeca and Amaranta vie for Pietro's attention.

videos.title: The Chestnut Tree
videos.overview: A new mayor and his family settle in Macondo. Aureliano experiences love for the first time, while a death drives José Arcadio into madness.

videos.title: Remedios Moscote
videos.overview: Arcadio becomes the school's principal, and Pilar has significant news for Aureliano. Remedios fills the Buendía home with joy — until tragedy strikes.

videos.title: Colonel Aureliano Buendía
videos.overview: José Arcadio Jr. returns, shocking everyone with his wild nature, specially Rebecca. Amid political unrest, Aureliano becomes a revolutionary leader.

videos.title: Arcadio and the Liberal Paradise
videos.overview: Arcadio enforces liberal rule in Macondo, while Aureliano attempts to free a colonel from the conservatives. The looming threat of war finally arrives.

videos.title: So Many Flowers Fell from the Sky
videos.overview: Years later, when Aureliano reveals his war plans for Macondo, a heartbroken Ursula comes to a shocking realization about her family.
